claims.statement: Entered as no. 2 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Language, Rhetoric and Grammar. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "Donatus in Italian and Latin".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Ianua (Ars minor in volgare). The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed 4th century · Printed later 15th century.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition

background.text: A bilingual edition of Aelius Donatus's elementary grammar, the standard first Latin book.
